rice.name: Rice
tips: Maintain 2-5cm standing water during tillering
Apply nitrogen fertilizer in 3 splits
Drain field 15 days before harvest

wheat.name: Wheat
tips: Irrigate at crown root initiation stage
First irrigation 21 days after sowing is critical
Avoid waterlogging during grain filling

groundnut.name: Groundnut
tips: Apply gypsum at flowering for better pod filling
Ensure well-drained soil to prevent aflatoxin
Harvest when 75% leaves turn yellow

cotton.name: Cotton
tips: Use Bt cotton varieties for bollworm resistance
Maintain spacing of 90×60cm
Pick cotton when bolls are fully open and dry

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane
tips: Earthing up at 90 and 120 days improves yield
Trash mulching reduces weed growth by 60%
Ratoon management can save 30% input costs

maize.name: Maize
tips: Critical irrigation at tasseling and silking stages
Apply zinc sulfate if soil zinc is deficient
Harvest at 20-25% grain moisture

soybean.name: Soybean
tips: Seed treatment with Rhizobium fixes atmospheric nitrogen
Maintain plant population of 4-4.5 lakh/hectare
Harvest when 95% pods turn brown

tomato.name: Tomato
tips: Stake plants to prevent fruit rot from soil contact
Mulching reduces water need by 30%
Harvest at pink stage for distant markets

onion.name: Onion
tips: Stop irrigation 10 days before harvest
Cure bulbs in shade for 7-10 days post-harvest
Use raised beds in areas with poor drainage

turmeric.name: Turmeric
tips: Apply mulch after planting to conserve moisture
Earthing up at 60 and 120 days
Harvest when leaves turn yellow and dry

chickpea.name: Chickpea (Chana)
tips: Requires minimal irrigation — excess water causes root rot
Good crop for rainfed areas
Nipping at 25 days increases branching

mustard.name: Mustard
tips: First irrigation at 30 days is critical
Aphid monitoring essential during flowering
Harvesting at physiological maturity prevents shattering loss

banana.name: Banana
tips: Drip irrigation saves 40% water vs flood irrigation
Propping of bunches prevents toppling
Desuckering keeps energy focused on main bunch

millet.name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
tips: Best crop for dry, sandy regions with low rainfall
Thinning at 10-12 days to maintain optimal spacing
Can withstand drought better than most cereals

chilli.name: Chilli
tips: Use drip irrigation to avoid leaf diseases
Pinching terminal buds increases lateral branching
Red ripe chillies fetch 30% higher price than green
